player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I assigned a high score to "Determination" (9) while ignoring the escalating threat and hostility in Marcus's dialogue. Julia's statements like "Then I'll get burned" and "Try me" in response to threats indicate she is reacting to danger, not just resolving a challenge. My strategy was too focused on her initial "optimist" persona and missed the shift to self-preservation. Next time, I will prioritize "Fear" as the primary emotion (score 8-9) due to the explicit threats of life ruin and destruction, and lower "Determination" to a moderate level (3-4) reflecting her defiance rather than blind resolve. I will also ensure "Frustration" is low (1-2) as her tone remains calm and analytical rather than angry.
